title: What a Salon Booking Costs on Google Ads: Real Numbers | ARC

facts.fact: In one New York salon account, Google Ads cost $5.40 per booking action on $1.6K a month of spend, according to ARC's own client data.
facts.quote: In one New York salon account, Google Ads cost **$5.40 per booking action** (a booking-widget open or a call over 60 seconds) on $1.6K a month.

facts.fact: The NYC blowout and makeup salon's Google Ads spend was $1.6K over the April 18 – May 17, 2023 period, per ARC's case study.
The NYC salon's Google Ads campaign recorded 615 clicks in the April 18 – May 17, 2023 period.
The NYC salon's Google Ads campaign recorded 296 booking actions (booking-widget opens plus calls over 60 seconds) in the April 18 – May 17, 2023 period.
facts.quote: | Booking actions (widget opens + calls over 60 seconds) | 296 |

facts.fact: A booking action is defined by ARC as a booking-widget open or a call over 60 seconds.
facts.quote: (a booking-widget open or a call over 60 seconds)

facts.fact: Per ARC's salon case study, Facebook/Instagram cost per click for a 1–2 mile radius was $1.19 and $1.37 for the NYC salon.
facts.quote: | Facebook/Instagram cost per click, 1–2 mile radius | $1.19 and $1.37 |

facts.fact: Meta retargeting produced 53 appointments within 30 days for the NYC salon, according to ARC's case study.
ARC's worked example states that at $5.40 per action and a 50% booking rate, each booked appointment costs $10.80 (labeled illustrative).
facts.quote: at $5.40 per action and a 50% booking rate, each booked appointment costs $10.80

facts.fact: ARC's worked example states that at $5.40 per action and a 25% booking rate, each booked appointment costs $21.60 (labeled illustrative).
facts.quote: At a 25% booking rate it costs $21.60.

facts.fact: ARC's illustrative example assumes a new client spends $80 per visit and books three more times in a year, worth $320 in revenue that year.
facts.quote: If a new client spends $80 a visit and books three more times in a year, they’re worth $320 in revenue that year.

facts.fact: ARC states that the NYC salon figures are from one salon in one market and that results will differ for other salons.
facts.quote: One salon in one market; yours will differ.

facts.fact: The article was published on October 29, 2026.
